section_path: Guest Operations — Embarkation and Safety Briefing
Procedure
chunks.text:
This procedure governs guest embarkation aboard MV Q-Horizon and the associated safety
briefing.

All guests must complete the briefing before departure. Attendance is recorded in the
planned maintenance system and reconciled against the manifest.

Where the monitoring instrument is outside its calibration interval, embarkation is paused
and the Fleet Technical Superintendent is notified before the vessel next sails.

Requirement basis: ISM Code Section 7 — development of plans for shipboard operations.

section_path: Non-Conformity — Fresh Water Generator — MV Q-Marina
Non-Conformity and Corrective Action
chunks.text:
Non-conformity raised during internal audit of MV Q-Marina.

Detail: a corroded securing arrangement noted on visual inspection concerning the Fresh
Water Generator aboard MV Q-Marina, where the monitoring instrument is outside its
calibration interval had not been actioned as required by procedure SMS-115.

Root cause: the recording step in the crew training record system was not completed at the
time of the check.

Corrective action: reinforce the procedure and verify at the next internal audit. Owner:
Designated Person Ashore.

chunks.text:

section_path: SMS Procedure — Ballast Water Treatment System Operation
Procedure and Records
chunks.text:
Confirm the Ballast Water Treatment System is in the condition required before operation.

Where the equipment shows evidence of damage or leakage, do not operate and raise a
defect record.

Record the check in the electronic logbook.

Report any a temperature log with a gap over the preceding period to the Fleet Technical
Superintendent within 14 days.

Records are retained on board and ashore and are subject to review during internal audit and
external inspection.
